verdict.rationale: Relay's bill-pay feature supports uploading bills, delegating tasks, and automating approval routing for vendor payments (relay-docs-4), which covers part of the 'routed for payment' requirement, but there is no evidence of purchase-order matching or invoice coding/GL categorization tied to bills. missing for 10: PO-to-invoice matching, invoice coding/GL account assignment, and any AI-native automated reconciliation workflow.
